gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-be-vietnam-p: Wide-spaced and cheeky: Early GameBoy stretches its letters out with a modest thick-thin shift and a skyward x-height. Be Vietnam Pro, a plain sans, keeps every stroke bent-rod smooth.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-cascadia-mono: Bold, gappy, unmissable: Wallpoet leaves paper showing between its letters. Cascadia Mono is sans-serif with stems and arcs in lockstep, each letter standing like a pin in a wide board.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-cascadia-code: Ink strokes that taper out before touching make Warnes instantly recognizable, spaced wide with no contrast. Cascadia Code is a sans with a wire-like monoline skeleton and plenty of room between neighbors.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-montserrat-alte: Expressive from the first glance, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width. Montserrat Alternates, a sans-serif, keeps a paragraph moving with open rounds whose rims match the stems.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-lexend-m: Barely-there ascenders that hardly clear the x-height give Love Ya Like A Sister its low, outward-pointing swagger. Lexend Mega, a sans, keeps things level beside it with its one-nib look.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-lexend-tera: Distinctive down to its generous sidebearings and high midline, Metamorphous shifts softly between fat and slim strokes. Lexend Tera, a plain sans, moves like a plotter-pen line with stepping-stone spacing.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-lexend-mega: Big, bold, relaxed: Revalia strides across widely separated letters with an open g. Lexend Mega, a plain sans, follows with its one-nib look and a body height nearly matching the capitals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-lexend-exa: Stretched out and inky, Warnes tapers every stroke before it touches. Lexend Exa, a sans with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, is worth giving a little extra room.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-lexend-peta: Reading flows smoothly through curves that never thin, while Grandstander shouts in constant-width lines. Lexend Peta, a sans with a big x-height, carries the reading; Grandstander grabs attention with held-open letters.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-lexend-zetta: Soft-edged drama: Metamorphous shifts gently between fat and slim strokes, high midline included. Lexend Zetta, a sans-serif, runs wide-tracked and tall-bodied, like a single-stroke brush of constant width.
